tittha.cp: neut. a fording or landing place; a harbour; a belief.
tittha.p: [Tara+tha=thaka] (na) CL=7 [Tara taraṇe, assa ittaṃ, pararūpādi, tarantunenāti titthaṃ, najjādiṃ yenāvataranti, taṃ. Ṇvādi. 88.(-nīti, dhā. 150. Sūci. Dhātvattha. 159).(tīthī-saṃ)] (1) Port. (A) Landing place for rivercraft, Riverside bathing place, A port where is to take water (such as from the water). (B) Riverside bathing and taking water place. See also -  pānatithta. (C) The port where is to rest the watercraft. (D) The land terminal where is to rest and stand the vehicle (such as a bullock cart). (2) The port. See - Titthagāma. (3) It is like a port. (4) Water, (A) Water which is near the port of the river. (B) Pure water. (5) 62 kinds of the wrong doctrine, The wrong doctrine. See also - Titthakara-(1). (6) The right doctrine. See - Titthakara-(1). (7) Pieces of faded clothing that throw at the riverside bathing place. See - Titthacoḷa, titthacoḷaka. (8) catupārisuddhisīla. (9) Ariyamagga, Arahattamagga. (10) Pariyatti dhamma which should listen and learn. See also - Dhammatithi. (11) who knows and understands Pariyatti dhamma, One who has much knowledge, a Knowledgable person, and A teacher. See also - Titthaññū. (12) The cause 'Upāya'. (13) It should subscribe as the port. See - Titthakusala. (14) The treatise.

titthāyatana：the 3 'articles of （heretical） belief'．which in A．III，61 are declared as leading to inactivity，are：（1） the belief that all happiness and woe are produced through former kamma （prenatal actions； s．kamma）； （2） that everything is uncaused； （3） that everything is created by God．

（1） is the teaching of Niggaṇṭha-Nāthaputta，the leader of the Niggaṇṭhas，the modern Jains．The fault with this doctrine is that it does not account for that happiness and woe which either are the result of the present life's good or bad action，or are associated with the corresponding action．（2） is the doctrine of Makkhali Gosāla； s．diṭṭhi．

According to the above 3 doctrines，man is not responsible for his actions，so that all moral exertions become useless．

titthāyatanasutta.p: [Titthāyatana+sutta] (na) CL=7 Titthāyatana-sutta. A sutta that preaches about three kinds of the wrong doctrine which are People, Creature suffer pain- (1) Pubbekatahetu = which causes due to the past Kamma that you did. (2) Issaranimmānahetu= which happens due to creation by Bissaṇa Deva, The forever God. (3)Ahetu, Apaccaya = which happens without cause.
